## Episode Thesis

This is a Norwegian personal-finance episode from VG, not an equity-focused show. It covers buying an electric car before New Year, when Norway's VAT exemption on EVs ends and prices could rise by up to NOK 75,000. It also compares ways to pay for a car: a separate car loan, adding it to the mortgage (costly if you don't raise the monthly payment), Storebrand's car loan secured on your home, campaign interest rates, leasing and consumer loans. Car makers and banks come up only as consumer examples: dealers are offering heavy discounts because new-car sales are weak. There are no investment views, so there are no directional signals.
